related_questions.question: What does a legacy benefit mean?
related_questions.snippet: Universal Credit is replacing older benefits These are called 'legacy benefits': Housing Benefit. income-related Employment and Support Allowance (ESA) income-based Jobseeker's Allowance (JSA) Income Support.
related_questions.title: Check if you should move to Universal Credit from other benefits

related_questions.question: Are all legacy benefits ending?
related_questions.snippet: All claimants of Income-Related ESA and Income-Related ESA with Housing Benefit will be asked to move to Universal Credit by the end of March 2026. Universal Credit hasn't replaced Contributory or New Style ESA.
related_questions.title: The migration process to Universal Credit from legacy benefits

related_questions.question: How many people are on legacy benefits?
related_questions.snippet: The most recent figures on the number of households on Universal Credit are for August 2024. 5.93 million households in Great Britain were on Universal Credit, and around 0.86 million households were on legacy benefits.
